title.narrative: Promotion of Mini-Grids in Northern Uganda (Pro Mini-Grids NU)

description.narrative: The goal of the Action is to improve the social and economic conditions in Northern Uganda by providing electricity to increase business and employment opportunities, and maximising the impact of electricity through improved production and resilience in the agricultural sector. The Action supports this goal by creating an improved national framework for scaled up implementation of private, decentralised power distribution with participation by the private sector. It uses a procurement and implementation model that can be replicated in any part of rural Uganda, even as funding becomes available beyond the action. During the Action, up to 25 villages, or more if funding allows, will be electrified with renewable energy-based mini-grids.
